drill_self_defect.summary: The drill's first CI run reported PASS while drilling nothing.
drill_self_defect.cause: The workflow's exemption check used an unanchored grep for the opt-out marker. The migration's comment explaining the opt-out quoted that literal token, so prose was read as a declaration and the migration was exempted.
drill_self_defect.why_it_looked_green: The adversarial fixture still passed, so the job's green was indistinguishable from a real pass.
drill_self_defect.class: fail-open: the control silently did nothing and reported success — the same class the drill exists to catch
fixes: both marker greps anchored to the start of a comment line
a guard declaration takes precedence over an exemption; declaring both fails closed
a run that drills zero detected migrations fails instead of reporting a green no-op
regression fixture asserting prose mentioning the exemption marker does not exempt a guarded migration
drill_self_defect.detected_by: reading the job's actual stdout rather than trusting its conclusion

guard_defect_found_by_drill.severity: the fail-closed precondition never worked as designed
guard_defect_found_by_drill.observed: SQLSTATE 22P02 'malformed array literal', not the declared 42P07, for each declared relation independently
guard_defect_found_by_drill.cause: existing := existing || 'public.foo' resolves to array-to-array concatenation with an untyped literal, so Postgres parses the relation name as an array literal and raises before reaching the RAISE
consequence: the message naming the operator authorization boundary was never emitted
the HINT pointing at `supabase migration repair --status applied` was never emitted
refusal happened only because the guard crashed on its own first statement
guard_defect_found_by_drill.what_still_held: refusal did occur and NO DDL ran -- schema fingerprint byte-identical before and after each refused attempt -- and the migration still applied in full on an empty schema
guard_defect_found_by_drill.missed_by: a PM verdict and an independent exact-head review both accepted this precondition's design by reading it; the defect is invisible to reading and only execution surfaced it
guard_defect_found_by_drill.status: fix pushed; 42P07 conformance remains PENDING until the drill re-runs green

independent_review.note: Deliberately empty. The authoring actor does not write verifier identity, method, or result into this bundle -- not even in a non-asserting form. On the predecessor lane a reviewer verdict was pre-written here before any review ran; a later reviewer observed that author-written verifier scaffolding is itself the anti-pattern, whether or not it asserts a result. Independent review verdicts are delivered to the PM in the review packet and live in the PR's own review artifacts, which the author cannot author.
